gaps: The supplied case refers to a complete working request body and changing only rfx_mode, but does not provide that body; the plan sends only the named rfx_mode field.
The available read-back fields do not expose the resulting round's rfx_mode or prove that the RFQ-then-auction round was created next to the existing RFQ round.
The evaluator and permission prerequisites cannot be set or verified with the available vocabulary.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the request that adds a round to the event, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
